brief.objective: Create a premium product hero shot that can receive exact logo and copy in post-production.
brief.subject: A matte dark-green aluminum bottle matching the product reference exactly
brief.action: Condensation slowly travels down the bottle while it rises 2 centimeters and then becomes completely still
brief.environment: Minimal dark-green studio with a warm beige stone plinth
brief.camera: 85mm product feel, controlled 25-degree clockwise orbit with a subtle push-in, settling centered
brief.lighting: Large soft source from camera-left, weak warm edge light, restrained reflections on the matte surface
brief.sound: Low restrained cinematic pulse, subtle condensation texture, one soft impact exactly when the bottle settles
brief.endpoint: Bottle perfectly upright and centered in a stable three-quarter view
brief.style: Contemporary premium commercial photography, matte materials, realistic condensation, no glossy CGI look
constraints: product proportions remain identical to the reference
frame remains free of generated typography
background stays minimal with no additional props

references.note: This is the exact product geometry and material reference; do not redesign it.
